system.description:
[Lightsaber Form]

You swing both of your Lightsabers in an arc toward the target, slamming them home with great force.

Time: Standard Action

Targets: One enemy within reach

Make a Use the Force check. The result of the check determines the effect, if any:

DC EFFECT
15 You make a single melee attack with a Lightsaber against your target. If this attack hits, add the base damage of your other Lightsaber to the damage roll.
25 You make a single melee attack with a Lightsaber against your target, with a +1 Force bonus to the attack roll. If this attack hits, add the base damage of your other Lightsaber to the damage roll.
30 You make a single melee attack with a Lightsaber against your target, with a +2 Force bonus to the attack roll. If this attack hits, add the base damage of your other Lightsaber to the damage roll.

Lightsaber Form (Jar'Kai): If you have the Jar'Kai Talent, you triple your deflection bonus from the Lightsaber Defense Talent instead of doubling it until the end of your next turn.

Special: You must be wielding two Lightsabers to use this Form Power. You can spend a Force Point to add +1 die of damage to the damage from your Lightsaber attack.
